targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: Of the 101 participants, 70 were classified as having the third or fourth type according to the data in the experimenter-provided STATA_data.xlsx, which comes to 69.306930693%. Notably, when I add the numbers directly from Table 4 in the paper (0.407 and 0.288), I get 69.5%, which doesn’t match either my recomputed value or the value reported in the main text of the paper. I further note that the value meets the approximate reproduction criterion.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Analyst success criteria: The reproduction will be considered a success if and only if all outcomes meet their associated precise reproduction criterion.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All four claims evaluated in final author-data attempt; three meet precise criteria, one explicitly fails with discrepant numbers despite approximate agreement. No alternative substantive specifications tested; modifications repair execution only.
